title: Private Console: Interactive Failure Scenario Simulator (VPC & Cluster UX prototype)
creator: Avery Chen
description: Prototype an interactive 'failure scenario' simulator inside the Private/VPC Console that lets operators replay cluster and network failure patterns, inspect automatic rollback/upgrade behaviors, and preview SLA and cost impact. The simulator should support composing multi-step failure traces (node kill, network partition, upgrade interruption, egress throttling), running them against a tenant-like environment, and surfacing recommended remediation actions and rollback toggles in a hands-on, explorable UX.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Initial kickoff: scoped simulator goals with Eng infra and SRE. Focus on 3 core scenarios: 1) regional network partition, 2) rolling upgrade failure, 3) tenant egress throttle. Action: sketch flows and map telemetry signals required.

2026-02-19 - Mid-fidelity wireframes reviewed with PM (Ravi Patel) and SRE (Dana Ortiz). PM requested an explicit 'impact slider' to tune severity for SLA delta preview. SRE asked for a toggle to inject synthetic KV cache misses.

2026-02-26 - Engineering feedback: runtime team can provide a lightweight sandbox API /simulate that returns event timelines and cost delta. Dependency: ENG-18124 (sandbox simulation API) to be delivered in parallel.

2026-03-03 - Usability session notes: operators wanted a playback timeline with per-step annotations and links to related incidents. Design updated to include a condensed step list for quick rollback.

2026-03-09 - Design review with Security & Compliance: confirm simulator actions are read-only in hosted console mode and require KMS-based approval in private/on-prem. Added security banner and permission gating.
2026-03-12 - Submitted prototype to Figma and requested front-end pairing week. Next: implement prototype PR and a small smoke test with two tenant examples before handoff to Eng.
Links included below reference the working artifacts and the integration PRs.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype demonstrates composing at least 3 failure scenarios and running them against a sandbox tenant
Timeline playback with step-level annotations and an ability to jump to a particular event
SLA & cost delta preview accurately reflects inputs from the simulation API (mocked if API not available)
Permission gating and security banner present for private/on-prem runs
Design assets (Figma) and a developer handoff doc are published and linked in the ticket
design_decisions: Simulator will operate in a sandbox mode by default; production-affecting actions require an explicit approval flow
Expose a severity slider to scale the intensity of synthetic failures (affects SLA delta calculations)
Provide 'quick rollback' and 'apply remediation' CTAs in the timeline UI; these map to documented runbook actions rather than immediate automated changes
Show per-tenant cost delta and aggregated cross-tenant risk summary for multi-tenant Dedicated clusters
notes: Trade-offs discussed: full destructive test harness is out of scope for this prototype; we will rely on simulated telemetry and mock tenants for the initial iteration.
Follow-up tasks: create ENG subtasks for API contracts, add a PM acceptance test plan, and schedule a cross-team demo in Cycle 43.
Design QA checklist: keyboard accessibility for timeline controls, color contrast for impact heatmap, and clear ARIA labels for simulator steps.
